detail: Rulebook F1, B1 to B14. Rewards earn in full; the register asks once per trip (use 80% today, or save; save is the default). Saved Rewards carry a use-by date 30 days after the receipt, on the receipt and in My account. Thrift+ credit (refund money) is kept apart, never expires, and is ALWAYS spent first, automatically; rewards only cover what is left (worked out before tax), and none are used when the credit covers the total. No Rewards on consignment items.
title: Rewards and Thrift+ credit, form 5: earned in full, use today at 80%, save for 30 days
